prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: insuring a holiday cottage. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When a holiday cottage is let to guests for part of the year, I should check the policy wording for business use, holiday letting, and any guest repairs, and how quickly the member can arrange a site inspection."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the claim involves theft or attempted theft, I should check for visible signs of forced entry and
